# developer.paypal.com documentation — Braintree — Docs — Guides — Fxaas

> 3 page(s) of developer.paypal.com documentation — Braintree — Docs — Guides under Fxaas. Part of the index one level up (../llms.txt).

## Fxaas

- [Foreign Exchange as a Service](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/fxaaS/overview/): Braintree's Foreign Exchange as a Service (FXaaS) is a currency-conversion service that enables businesses to display prices and accept payments in a buyer's local currency.
- [Get Started](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/fxaas/integration/): Braintree Foreign Exchange as a Service (FXaaS) is available to eligible merchants in the UK and EU.
- [Presentment currencies](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/fxaas/reference/): The currencies available to you depend on your account setup and the country where your company is located.
